title: Machine-learning prediction of DCAA and TCAA concentrations in drinking water
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00644A, Paper
Mengyu Liu, Wenzhong Huang, Caihong Yu, Hongyu Zhang, Li Lin, Zhuwu Jiang
PSO-BPNN reads 8 routine metrics, quickly forecasts DCAA/TCAA with R2 > 0.98 & N25 > 98%, and gives plants an instrument-free, low-cost, real-time DBP alert.
